item.title: War on All Fronts
item.content:encoded: Welcome to War on All Fronts, an attempt to make a canon. It's not a canon yet, but we have two authors who have expressed interest in making stuff for it, so once they post it'll be a canon. (It also go to the point where a Hub page would be useful)
